card.name: Start of hospitalization and cross-reactivity
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word, mainly "hospital" before "-ization" and "cross" before "-reactivity". It appears in warnings and risk statements.

modes.label: hospital before -ization
modes.description: The word "hospital" is the start of "hospitalization" in lists of outcomes or risks.

modes.label: cross before -reactivity
modes.description: The word "cross" begins "cross-reactivity" between aspirin and other NSAIDs.
modes.example: Because<< cross>>-reactivity between aspirin and other NSA
